items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: He knocked on the door and said, Lizzy, come see your man going down the street with Fanny Bryce.

ctx.x: And Jelly Roll took that other voice in there.
Yes. Yeah. He knocked on the door and said, Lizzy, come see your man going down the street with Fanny Bryce. Or Fanny something. Jelly was quite a fella.
